column2: I can't find my daughter anywhere...\n\nEver since the Japanese government abandoned Kanto, nothing but outlaws gather here... I'm so worried about Ayuko...
It's been a few years since the Kanto Hellquake, but life's still awful. In a world ruled by violence, the weak just suffer...
Something's not right about this village.
Looks like there was a huge earthquake.
The Kanto Hellquake?
Yeah. It sure feels like a few years after a big quake...
I wonder if this is Panther Claw's doing too?
Don't recognize your faces... Outsiders, huh? You planning to live in this town?
Meh, if I like it!
Then you'd best report to the police.
P-POLICE!? Wh-what the hell!? That kinda thing still exists?
Quit joking. Wasn't Kanto supposed to be lawless?
Um, excuse me. There's a police station here?
Don't recognize your faces either, do I?
Tee-hee... I'm Honey Kisaragi.
I'm {p}.
And I'm Seiji Hayami, newspaper reporter.
A newspaper reporter?
Ooh, this one's dreamy too!
*Ba-dump!*
Don't get fooled, Mr. Reporter. That one's a guy.
Whaaat!?
A newspaper reporter, and you don't know who we are? Mondo Saotome of the radicals, the "Fangs of God"...
...and Ryoma Shindo.
Nope. Never heard of you.
We're in trouble! The Dragons are coming!
What!?
If you don't wanna die, you'd better run too!
It's over! The Dragons chased HIM here! He's gonna bring ruin to this town too!
Yeah, let's go!
Him? Who could they mean?
Let's go have a look too!
Ooh, she's cute!
Mondo?
Eeeeek!
It's the Dragons! The Dragons are coming!
H-h-h-help meee!
Wh-what!? That huge guy!
That's the giant they call the Monster of Kanto.
Muscles of a gorilla! Fangs of a wolf! Burning eyes, the fire of the primeval!
Seven foot two, every inch of him packed with fighting energy. His name is Jack!
Violence Jack!
Violence Jack...
And what's that bearing down on us?
It's like a band of mounted warriors from the Warring States era!
The Slum King rules lawless Kanto, and that's the army he put together: the Dragons.
GRAAAAAAH!!
He's going to fight them all by himself!
Honey! Don't tell me you're gonna help him!? They're a whole cavalry!
Even so, we can't just let that giant die!
What do we do, Mondo?
If I'm gonna run Kanto and be its emperor, I gotta take down both the King and Jack. This is a good chance to size 'em up.
So then...
Yeah, let's kick back and enjoy the show.\n\nA show this good don't come around often!
Why did you help me?
Why...? Well, I figured you'd get killed all on your own...
Wh-what?
Your name... What is your name...?
Get mixed up with me and you won't walk away clean.\n\nAre you fine with that!? {p}!!
Wh-what do you mean?
Heard the rumors. Look that guy in the eye and anybody goes nuts. The gleam of his jackknife wakes up the primeval in people.
That's right. Even folks living quiet little lives can't help but fight.\n\nAnyone who gets involved with him gets dragged into battle, every time. That's Violence Jack...!
B-but that's...
Well, we sure got dragged into a fight...
...I just couldn't leave him.
..........\n\nI sense an energy in you unlike any I've ever met. I'll stay with you for a while.
Well, if that's how it is, count me in too.
H-hey, wait...!
Mondo, what are you thinking?
We get Jack owing us one. Even I can't take on two monsters at once, that's too much. You know what they say: the enemy of my enemy is my friend.
I guess...
What are you two whispering about...?
You two...?
You aren't plotting something, are you?
No way! You're overthinking it, right?
Damn right! For guys like us who can't live in a normal world, Kanto's the promised land!\n\nIt's got the freedom we've been looking for! Watching you fight just got my blood pumping, that's all!
Heh heh heh... Is that so? This place is Hell, you know. Hahahahaha...!!
Hell...
The Dragons were beaten by Violence Jack?
F-forgive us!!\n\nWe had him cornered, one step from the kill, but some strangers got in our way...
Strangers...?
Well, sire... It seems... th-they were children...
You mean to tell me the Dragons were beaten by children!?
F-forgive us!!
I'll hear no excuses!
What is it, Queen? You look pale.

...Last night I had a dream.

A dream that those who appeared with the black moon would destroy the world. They were a boy and a girl.

The strange match between that dream and the report just now troubles me...
Fear not, Queen!\n\nI shall lead the Dragons myself and crush Violence Jack!
Yes, sire!
You fought the Dragons and lived, huh... But that big guy, is he the real Violence Jack?
You know, they say any town Violence Jack shows up in is doomed...
They say that all over Kanto.
Did you find Ayuko-chan?
I haven't found her, but I know where she is... It seems she was taken to the Reaper Police HQ...
Wh-what!?
Isn't the police a good thing, though?
You only say that because you don't know anything.
